defmodule Logistics.Freight.Carrier do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "carriers"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]

    update :destroy do
      primary? true
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        Ash.Changeset.after_action(changeset, fn _changeset, result ->
          {:ok, result}
        end, fn _changeset, error ->
          if Enum.any?(error.errors, &match?(%{field: :shipments, message: "carrier still has shipments"}, &1)) do
            {:error, error}
          else
            {:error, error}
          end
        end)
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :code, :ci_string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :name, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :retired_at, :utc_datetime_usec
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :shipments, Logistics.Freight.Shipment, destination_attribute: :carrier_id
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_code, [:code], eager_check?: true, message: "has already been taken",
             partial_filter: expr(is_nil(retired_at))
  end

  # Partial filter: read must only return live carriers
  pre_prepare_filter do
    expr(is_nil(retired_at))
  end

  # Ensure destroy checks referential integrity
  changes do
    change fn changeset, _ ->
      if changeset.action.type == :destroy do
        # Force a constraint error if there are related shipments

            {:error, Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [error])}

            {:error, _err}
          end
        end)
      else
        changeset
      end
    end
  end
end

  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "shipments"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]

    create :intake do
      argument :reference, :string
      argument :declared_value_cents, :integer
      argument :scheduled_for, :utc_datetime
      argument :carrier_id, :uuid
      argument :origin_warehouse_id, :uuid
      argument :parcels, {:array, :map}

      accept [:reference, :declared_value_cents, :scheduled_for, :carrier_id, :origin_warehouse_id]

      change fn changeset, _ ->
        parcels = Ash.Changeset.get_argument(changeset, :parcels)
        changeset = Ash.Changeset.manage_relationship(changeset, :parcels, parcels, type: :create)
        changeset
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :status, :atom, allow_nil?: false, constraints: [one_of: [:draft, :booked, :in_transit, :delivered, :cancelled]], default: :draft
    attribute :declared_value_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false, default: 0
    attribute :scheduled_for, :utc_datetime
    attribute :booked_at, :utc_datetime_usec, default: &DateTime.utc_now/0
    attribute :carrier_id, :uuid, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :origin_warehouse_id, :uuid
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :carrier, Logistics.Freight.Carrier, allow_nil?: false
    belongs_to :origin_warehouse, Logistics.Freight.Warehouse, allow_nil?: true

    has_many :parcels, Logistics.Freight.Parcel, destination_attribute: :shipment_id
    has_many :legs, Logistics.Freight.ShipmentLeg, destination_attribute: :shipment_id
  end

  aggregates do
    aggregate :parcel_count, :parcels, :count, join_filter: [parcels: expr(true)]
    aggregate :total_weight_grams, :parcels, :sum, :weight_grams
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :heavy?, :boolean, expr(total_weight_grams > 5000)
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_reference, [:reference], eager_check?: true, message: "has already been taken"
  end
end
